options.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API (default probes: http://localhost:11434/v1, http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1, http://localhost:1234/v1).

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key (if required by the server).

commands.name: show
commands.description: Display current local LLM configuration.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json, or compact/JSONL (default: table). [default: table]

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Remove all stored local LLM settings.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Test connectivity to the local LLM server.

commands.name: cli
commands.description: Manage connected Advantage CLI workers.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Ask a connected CLI worker to restart via dnx and pick up the latest adv package.

options.name: --package-version
options.description: Optional adv package version to restart into. Defaults to latest stable.

options.name: --restart-only
options.description: Restart through dnx without forcing an upgrade action. [default: False]

arguments.name: DEVICEID
arguments.description: Connected CLI device ID, platform alias (windows/macos), or WebSocket GUID.

commands.name: connection
commands.description: Manage live backend connections.

commands.name: close
commands.description: Ask a live connection to shut down gracefully. Currently supported by Advantage CLI workers.

options.name: --reason
options.description: Reason sent to the client before it closes.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json, or compact/JSONL (default: table). [default: table]

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Connection ID, device ID, or platform alias.

commands.name: drop
commands.description: Force-remove a connection from backend state without waiting for the client.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json, or compact/JSONL (default: table). [default: table]

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Connection ID, device ID, or platform alias.

commands.name: bot
commands.description: Telegram Bot debugging: status, simulate messages, stream webhooks.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show Telegram Bot status and configuration.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json, or compact/JSONL (default: table). [default: table]

options.name: --interval
options.description: Poll interval in seconds (default: 5, used with --watch). [default: 5]

commands.name: send
commands.description: Simulate a text message to the bot.

options.name: --user-id
options.description: Telegram user ID (default: first allowed ID).

options.name: --chat-id
options.description: Telegram chat ID (default: same as user-id).

commands.name: command
commands.description: Simulate a bot command (e.g. /menu, /claude).

options.name: --user-id
options.description: Telegram user ID (default: first allowed ID).

options.name: --chat-id
options.description: Telegram chat ID (default: same as user-id).

commands.name: callback
commands.description: Simulate a callback query (inline keyboard button press).

options.name: --user-id
options.description: Telegram user ID (default: first allowed ID).

options.name: --chat-id
options.description: Telegram chat ID (default: same as user-id).

commands.name: inline
commands.description: Simulate an inline query.

options.name: --user-id
options.description: Telegram user ID (default: first allowed ID).

commands.name: webhooks
commands.description: Stream raw webhook traffic in real-time (SSE).

options.name: --raw
options.description: Print raw JSON instead of formatted output. [default: False]

commands.name: forum-topics
commands.description: Show forum thread map (context → topic ID).

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json, or compact/JSONL (default: table). [default: table]
